objective: On open and reopen, Connect Cluster/Organization/Personal thread reveals latest messages without transient top-of-history auto-pagination, while preserving deliberate older-message reading.
productionBaselineEvidence: Read current GitHub main source at 7b224c39624827282c3cbf003060317045b0a73f (2026-11-23). Existing Android production runtime 1.3.2 is described in prior release marker PR #1105; current served OTA not independently verified. DEV-only source; no production publication.
chosenApproach: Remove 64ms Android-offline-cache auto-anchor race, wait for measured FlatList layout, and require real upward drag/momentum before top-edge older-history fetch. Keep existing FlatList initial opacity gate, one latest anchor, explicit Load Earlier button and read/reaction/ads behavior.
alternativeApproaches: Always scroll to end on every render (rejected: steals the user's reading position and causes rebound)
Flip list inversion (rejected: changes older paging, item order and read cursors)
selectionRationale: Small source-only fix in existing chat component with executable guard regression; no new native package, backend migration, PTT, AdMob placement or release channel changes.
preserveBehaviors: Personal, Cluster and Organization share message-thread renderer
Only deliberate earlier-history reading or explicit button triggers pagination
Own-message and latest-content following, read cursor and offline cache
AdMob placement, call routing, notes, reactions and attachment viewing
acceptanceChecks: Open/reopen existing long Cluster room at newest message, no top flash or rebound
Fast scope switch or offline cache hydration does not auto-fetch older history
Drag upward can request one older page; prepend maintains visible offset
Incoming message, send, keyboard resize, read receipt, ad first view, instant tab navigation retain existing behavior
Android exact-runtime RC and served production receipt are release blockers
Existing Connect rebound and read-cursor isolation suites remain independent wider-PR regression gates; scope's changed-test runner executes only the two new changed tests.
